title: A Meta Survey of Quality Evaluation Criteria in Explanation Methods
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on establishing and analyzing evaluation criteria for AI explanations, with significant attention given to core ethical principles. It dedicates sections to discussing criteria such as 'Fairness' (defined as the degree to which predictions are unbiased and non-discriminatory), 'Bias (detection)', and 'Privacy'. These are not peripheral mentions but are treated as fundamental aspects of explanation quality, making the paper centrally related to AI ethics.
